topics.title: Fed decision keeps markets cautious
topics.summary: Wall Street held mostly steady as investors waited for a Federal Reserve rate decision, with oil prices and bond yields easing from recent highs.
topics.discussionPrompt: If everyone waits for one announcement before making a move, who stays calm and who refreshes the numbers every ten seconds?

topics.title: House challenges Iran war powers
topics.summary: The U.S. House again passed a war-powers measure aimed at ending unauthorized military operations in Iran, though a veto fight remains likely.
topics.discussionPrompt: When lawmakers argue over who gets to say yes to a war, who cares most about the rulebook and who just wants the fighting to stop?

topics.title: Surgeon general nominee faces questions
topics.summary: Dr. Nicole Saphier faced Senate scrutiny over vaccine policy, qualifications, and financial ties as the administration tries to fill the U.S. surgeon general role.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a public-health job interview becomes national drama, who asks about credentials and who asks whether anyone will trust the advice?

topics.title: AI safety consensus meets friction
topics.summary: Major AI leaders voiced rare agreement on slowing frontier development for safety, but enforcement, competition, and antitrust concerns remain unresolved.
topics.discussionPrompt: When rival companies suddenly agree to slow down, who thinks it is responsible and who wonders what they are protecting?

topics.title: Ice loss study raises alarms
topics.summary: A new satellite-based study estimates Greenland and Antarctica have lost more than 12 trillion tons of ice since 1979, adding to sea-level rise.
topics.discussionPrompt: If an inch of sea-level rise sounds small until the flooding map appears, who changes their mind first?

topics.title: EU plans firefighting fleet
topics.summary: After a punishing heatwave and wildfire season, the European Union announced plans for a larger shared firefighting fleet and heatwave response plan.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a whole region starts sharing emergency gear, who likes the teamwork and who asks why it took this long?

topics.title: Heathrow climate condition debated
topics.summary: UK climate advisers said a third Heathrow runway should proceed only if airlines pay for cleaner flying and carbon removal commitments.
topics.discussionPrompt: When travel plans meet climate math, who wants the runway and who starts asking exactly where the emissions go?

topics.title: Britain sees butterfly boom
topics.summary: Britain recorded its second-best butterfly count in 16 years after record heat, though conservationists warned drought could hurt next year’s caterpillars.
topics.discussionPrompt: If one summer brings more butterflies but maybe fewer next year, who enjoys the moment and who worries about the pattern?

topics.title: US confirms space weapons
topics.summary: The U.S. acknowledged it has deployed space-control weapons, intensifying debate over orbital security and military competition with Russia and China.
topics.discussionPrompt: If space stops feeling neutral, who wants strict treaties and who says defense has to follow the threat?

topics.title: Microplastics soil warning grows
topics.summary: Scientists warned microplastics in soil can act like carriers for toxins, raising concerns about farms, ecosystems, and long-term food-chain effects.
topics.discussionPrompt: When pollution hides under everyone’s feet, who wants better testing and who immediately looks suspiciously at the garden?
